dedupe_keys.name: montelupo fiorentino public green space maintenance intervention programme

description: The Municipality of Montelupo Fiorentino publishes a programme of ordinary maintenance interventions through two JSON distributions. One is labelled as the latest-period programme; the other covers interventions from the start of monitoring in 2024. The latter resource description explicitly limits its current validity to public green space. This provides a source-defined municipal maintenance operation for managed public space. The metadata does not establish that planned work was completed, how interventions were selected or whether the two distributions have disjoint records. Coverage is Montelupo Fiorentino, Tuscany, Italy. Distribution metadata was refreshed on 9 October 2026; no end date or observation frequency is stated for the intervention history. The package names Creative Commons Attribution without a version, and it is available through the Tuscany open-data portal. Exact licence terms, additional access conditions and costs remain unspecified. No JSON data body was obtained. Field names, dates of individual works, locations, quantities and a specific simulation use are unverified. Other municipal packages describe property subject to interventions and maintenance zones, but their empty descriptions do not prove that they belong to this same green-space programme; they are retained as unresolved companion leads.
